page.overview:
Who is Adoro?

After her partner Olu had a run in with his old flame, he would order her to punch the gas as Wakanda's interim Black Panther got onto their trail.

She and her two friends would spend their time passing out the food they stole to the impoverished section where the trio lived. But as they were enjoying their spoils, Ngozi crashed their celebration demanding to know why it was that they went stealing from her parents.

Conflagration erupted as Adoro knocked the wind out of the Symbiote enhanced Regent just before she and her partners were entering battle stances. They quickly found themselves to be outmatched by the crippled turned champion however, as her fury at they're transgressions caused the Klyntar she adorned to morph her into a monstrous dragon who near destroyed everything in their path.

Adoro would grab her two companions and flee the scene before things escalated.
